responsibility: Provides the main serialization logic for writing LTO GIMPLE and related metadata on the writer side. It creates and destroys output_block objects with main/cfg/string streams and tree caches, decides which tree nodes are streamed by reference versus inline, emits location and mode-table data, and finally produces the global declarations section, per-function declaration-state references, symbol tables, and option sections after function bodies and IPA summaries have been serialized. This is the core output streamer implementation, distinct from the lower-level section-writing and compression wrappers.
